answer: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) FROM account a JOIN loan l ON l.account_id = a.account_id WHERE a.district_id = 1 AND l.status IN ('C', 'D')
SELECT DISTINCT a.frequency, t.k_symbol FROM account a JOIN trans t ON a.account_id = t.account_id WHERE a.account_id = 3 AND t.amount = 3539
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT district_id) FROM district WHERE A11 > 6000 AND A11 < 10000

SELECT a.account_id FROM account a JOIN disp d ON a.account_id = d.account_id JOIN client c ON d.client_id = c.client_id JOIN district di ON c.district_id = di.district_id WHERE c.gender = 'F' ORDER BY c.birth_date ASC, di.A11 ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT d.district_id FROM district d JOIN client c ON c.district_id = d.district_id JOIN disp dp ON dp.client_id = c.client_id WHERE c.gender = 'F' AND dp.type = 'OWNER' GROUP BY d.district_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 9
